use_case: Use the estimate request form during trade change-order development and acceptance when the change order record must identify base work order, directive, affected task, location, pricing basis, schedule activity, and approval chain. Complete the applicable handoff for accepted price and days, revised work order, cost and schedule posting, field release, and distribution record.
